Definition: a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to a pillar
BiblicalUsage: 1) network, lattice-work, net, netting; 1a) lattice; 1b) net-ornament (on pillars); 1c) network, toils (for catching animals)
